name: Redridge Goulash
summary: In Lakeshire, Redridge Goulash feeds a town under strain. During the recent Blackrock orc uprising, Chef Breanna fed the Stormwind garrison until her pantry was bare, and now seeks hearty ingredients in the mountains.

sections.title: A Bare Mountain Pantry
sections.body: Blackrock orcs, gnolls, and fierce wild beasts still besiege Lakeshire. When the recent orc uprising began along the ridges, Chef Breanna took charge of feeding the Stormwind brigade stationed in town. The active garrison soon emptied her cupboards, while many hungry mouths remained.

sections.title: Mountain Bounty
sections.body: With her cupboards bare, Chef Breanna turns to the dangerous wilderness beyond Lakeshire's gates. Her signature goulash calls for tough mountain condor meat, seasoned snouts from Great Goretusks, and crisp leg meat from giant tarantulas prowling the hills.

faq.q: Why is Chef Breanna out of food supplies?
faq.answer: During the recent Blackrock orc uprising, Chef Breanna fed the Stormwind brigade stationed to defend Lakeshire. Keeping the active garrison supplied emptied her cupboards.

faq.q: What ingredients are used to make Redridge Goulash?
faq.answer: Redridge Goulash calls for five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts, and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat, gathered from creatures in the surrounding mountains.
Chef Breanna tends her hearth and cooking kettles in Lakeshire, along the northern shores of Lake Everstill in the Redridge Mountains.

faq.q: Why doesn't Lakeshire just import food from Stormwind City?
faq.answer: Orcs, Blackrock raiders, and gnolls choke the mountain passes, while Stormwind's resources are stretched thin. Lakeshire often depends on local wildlife and visiting adventurers for food.

faq.q: Is Redridge Goulash considered a delicacy?
faq.answer: Chef Breanna and Lakeshire's frontier folk consider the finished dish a hearty mountain delicacy. Its spider meat, boar snouts, and leathery condor flesh may sound harsh to outsiders.

faq.q: What brigade did Breanna have to feed?
faq.answer: Chef Breanna cooked for the Stormwind soldiers stationed in Lakeshire to push back the Blackrock orc forces pressing down from the northern ridges.

angles.text: As a cook exploring the Eastern Kingdoms, you can see Chef Breanna turn fierce mountain beasts into sustaining, savory fare.
As an Alliance member, you can see how the Blackrock orc invasion strains Lakeshire's stores, garrisons, and civilian life.
